Application.title: Application
Application.description: A multi-step digital loan application containing applicant, income, KYC, and document metadata.

id.description: Unique reference ID of the application.

fullName.description: Full legal name of the applicant.

email.description: The email address of the applicant.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Authentication user ID.

status.description: Current processing status of the application.

isDefaulter.description: True if the applicant is flagged as a defaulter in the central database.

Defaulter.title: Defaulter
Defaulter.description: A registry entry tracking flagged defaulters by PAN or Aadhaar card.

applicationId.description: The loan application ID that prompted the flagging.

fullName.description: Legal name of the flagged defaulter.

markedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the individual was flagged.

AdminNote.title: AdminNote
AdminNote.description: A private note or comment appended to an application by an administrator.

note.description: The private text content of the note.

createdBy.description: The email or UID of the admin who wrote the note.

applications/{applicationId}.description: Contains submitted and in-progress loan applications.

applications/{applicationId}/adminNotes/.description: Private notes and comments appended to a loan application by administrators.

defaulters/{identityId}.description: Registry of blacklisted PAN/Aadhaar combos with default descriptions.
